_phase_tag: Rockford line — station usage by axle model
_step_title: ST400/ST500 subassembly stations vs axle model
_recorded_by: Mohammed Pulikkal (Comer mechanical engineer), platform note 2026-07-16
_verified_by: relayed directly by Mohammed for the plant-layout mapping work

facts.fact: There is no data for stations ST400-410 in the Full_stations_report because the axle model covered by that report is a Quad Track. ST400 is the axle mount (Stage 3 subassembly) used for other types of axles — the LW and SW models.
facts.applies_when: when asked why ST400-410 shows no MES data on the facility map

citation.transcript_quote: No data for station 400-410 because the axle model in the report is a Quad Track, and 400 is the axle mount for other types of axles (LW and SW).

facts.fact: Whether a build runs through ST400 or ST500 depends on the model of the axle being built: ST400 serves the LW and SW axle models, while the Quad Track build in the current report uses ST500. The station set for any given order follows the axle model.
facts.applies_when: when asked which stations a given axle model uses, or why some stations are idle for a build

citation.transcript_quote: The use of ST400 and ST500 depends on the model of the axle build.
